title: Iran says tankers destroyed after hitting mines in Strait of Hormuz
summary: TEHRAN — Four oil tankers caught fire after hitting mines while attempting to pass through the Strait of Hormuz, Iran said Wednesday, after it warned no one would benefit from a return to war.…

blocks.text: TEHRAN — Four oil tankers caught fire after hitting mines while attempting to pass through the Strait of Hormuz, Iran said Wednesday, after it warned no one would benefit from a return to war.
